settings.heading: Cookies and browser storage
settings.lede: See what the exhibition remembers on this browser and how to clear it.

settings.heading: Cart, account, and checkout
settings.text: Shopify can use cookies to maintain the entry, cart, account and checkout sessions. Your browser settings and any Shopify privacy controls shown manage those choices separately.

settings.heading: Preferences stored on this device
settings.text: The theme can remember cooking preferences and an optional email, the Kansa conversation, saved cookware and sound or motion preferences in this browser. Those settings can persist between visits. Short-lived storage remembers parts of the current visit, such as whether you dismissed the cooking questionnaire.

settings.heading: Clear your visit
settings.text: Choose [ Reset Session & Storage ] in the footer to clear this storefront’s local and session storage in the current browser. To clear remaining site cookies, use your browser’s site-data settings. Information you send through Shopify forms, accounts or checkout is stored separately.
